Hi Liam,

Thanks for coming back to me. There is a lighter menu that suits 40 guests well. It keeps the grazing table and drops the oysters and the second dessert.

| Menu | Per head |
| --- | --- |
| Full grazing | $52 |
| Lighter grazing | $41 |

Both include staff, platters and clean-up at Wharf Hall.

If the lighter menu works, the deposit is due by 20 March to hold Saturday 18 April. Could you also send me any dietary requirements for your guests when you have them?

Cheers, Nadia

Liam!

We can do a discount: $30 a head, flavor of your choice. Pay the deposit soon.

Nadia
